mechanism: Cimetidine inhibits hepatic microsomal enzymes (CYP450) which may impair vitamin K metabolism and potentially reduce its anticoagulant antagonist effects, particularly relevant in patients on warfarin.
action: Monitor INR closely if cimetidine is initiated or discontinued in patients receiving warfarin; consider alternative H2-blocker (ranitidine, famotidine) or PPI if significant INR changes occur.
